Never allow two appointments for the same groomer at the same time.

# Deploy Paws & Suds Booking

From this package to a live app your customers can use. Takes about 30 minutes the first time.

> **Prefer us to do it?** On your build page, **Deploy for me** puts the app online in your own Vercel account and a
> new database for you in about 5 minutes, and updates this package with the live address. It is optional.

## 1 · What you need

- A **PostgreSQL** database (managed: Neon, Supabase, Scaleway, AWS RDS…).
- A **host for Node.js 24** (Vercel, Railway, Render, Fly.io, or your own server).
- Your **domain** (optional at first; the host gives you a temporary address).

## 2 · Settings (environment variables)

Set these in your host's dashboard. Never commit them to the repository.

| Required | What it is |
|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | Connection string of your production PostgreSQL database. |
| `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` | Random secret of at least 32 characters (for example `openssl rand -base64 32`). Never reuse it. |
| `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | The public address of the app, for example `https://app.yourcompany.com`. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | Comma-separated emails allowed to open the admin panel. |
| `ADMIN_EMAILS` | Comma-separated emails allowed to open the admin panel. |

| Optional | What it is |
|---|---|
| `RESEND_API_KEY` | Resend API key to send emails (verification, invitations). Required in production: without it the app refuses to start, unless you set `EMAIL_DELIVERY=disabled` to run without email on purpose. Email links are never written to logs. |
| `EMAIL_FROM` | Sender, for example `"Your App <hello@yourcompany.com>"` (domain verified in Resend). |
| `TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS` | How many proxies in front of the app add the visitor's address to `X-Forwarded-For` (Vercel: leave empty; behind one Nginx/Caddy: `1`). Without it, per-visitor limits do not trust that header. |

## 3 · Go live — option A: Vercel + Neon (simplest)

1. Push this repository to your GitHub (the "Push to my GitHub" button does it for you).
2. In Neon, create a project and copy its connection string → `DATABASE_URL`.
3. In Vercel: **Add New → Project →** import the repository. Framework: Next.js. Add the settings from step 2.
4. Create the tables once from your computer: `pnpm install && DATABASE_URL="<your url>" pnpm db:migrate`.
5. Deploy. Then set `BETTER_AUTH_URL` to the final address (your domain) and redeploy.

## 3 · Go live — option B: your own server

```bash
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm db:migrate        # with DATABASE_URL set
pnpm build
pnpm start --port 3000 # behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS (Caddy, Nginx)
```

## 4 · First steps in the app

1. Open the app and **sign up**: you become the owner of the first workspace.
2. Invite your team from the workspace settings and give each person the right role (owner, admin, member).
3. Check the **next steps** and any **alerts** in [TURBINEH_REPORT.md](TURBINEH_REPORT.md) before inviting customers.

## Keep it healthy

- Turn on **daily database backups** in your database provider.
- Add **error monitoring** (for example Sentry) and uptime checks.
- Keep dependencies updated (`pnpm outdated`); [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) lists any open advisories.
- When you change the data model: `pnpm db:generate`, commit the migration, then `pnpm db:migrate` on deploy.

# Paws & Suds Booking app built

We built an appointment scheduling system for a dog grooming salon. Customers can book as guests and groomers can manage their calendars. The app tracks services, customers, groomers, appointments, and time off.

## Acceptance criteria

- ⬜ Given a customer selects a 'bath' service, when they pick a time, the system reserves a 40-minute slot. — _Not verified automatically_
- ⬜ Given a customer selects a 'full groom' service, when they pick a time, the system reserves a 90-minute slot. — _Not verified automatically_
- ⬜ Given a customer selects a 'nail trim' service, when they pick a time, the system reserves a 15-minute slot. — _Not verified automatically_
- ⬜ Given a customer selects 'any groomer', when they book, the system assigns the first available groomer for that time. — _Not verified automatically_
- ✅ Given a customer completes a booking without an account, when the booking is processed, a confirmation email is sent containing a cancellation link. — _End-to-end test: a customer books a free time on the public page without an account: provides name, email and phone, the booking is created and a confirmation email with a cancel link is sent_
- ✅ Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is more than 12 hours before the appointment, the booking is successfully cancelled. — _End-to-end test: a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused_
- ✅ Given a customer clicks the cancellation link, when the current time is less than 12 hours before the appointment, the cancellation is denied. — _End-to-end test: a customer cancels the booking with the link of the confirmation email more than the notice hours before the start time; inside the notice period the link is refused_
- ✅ Given a groomer logs in, when they view their calendar, they can toggle between daily and weekly views. — _End-to-end test: a staff member signs in and sees the bookings in the day and week calendar per team member (stylist, therapist…)_
- ✅ Given a groomer uses the calendar, when they block a day off, no appointments can be scheduled for that groomer on that date. — _End-to-end test: a staff member blocks time off to make those time slots unavailable for booking; customers are no longer offered them_
- ✅ Given a groomer manages the calendar, when they move or cancel an appointment, a notification email is automatically sent to the customer. — _End-to-end test: a staff member moves an existing booking to a different time slot, then cancels it, triggering an automated email to the customer each time_
- ✅ Given a booking attempt is made, when the selected time slot is already occupied for the chosen groomer, the system prevents the booking. — _End-to-end test: a customer cannot book a slot already taken: the same time is never booked twice for one team member (double booking prevented)_

## Security

**All checks passed. One high advisory remains in a development-only tool and does not reach your users.**

- The app is protected by security headers and content security policy, input validation, role-based access checks, rate limiting, and safe error messages.
- Nothing was fixed automatically before delivery.
- One alert remains: a high advisory in braces@3.0.3. It affects a development-only tool used to build or test the app. It is not shipped to your users and is not reachable at runtime.

> None of the remaining alerts can be fixed automatically, so no improvement is offered. They are explained above.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for scope, tools and what was not checked.

## Next steps

1. A high advisory exists in braces@3.0.3, a development-only tool not shipped to users; no patched version exists yet, so update it when one is released.
1. Before deploying, set DATABASE_URL, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and BETTER_AUTH_URL in your hosting environment.
